## Hermes digest – llamacpp-vulkan
08:14 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile llamacpp-vulkan.

GitHub search (unauthenticated): PRs/issues updated and commits since yesterday that mention Vulkan in the title, labels or commit message. Merged PRs first. One LLM call without tools writes a one-line change summary per item; without it the bullets show only the linked titles. Nothing new = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
